SELECT v.first_name, v.last_name
FROM visitor AS v
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM visit AS vi
    JOIN museum AS m ON m.Museum_ID = vi.Museum_ID
    WHERE vi.visitor_ID = v.ID AND CAST(m.Open_Year AS INTEGER) < 2009
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM visit AS vi
    JOIN museum AS m ON m.Museum_ID = vi.Museum_ID
    WHERE vi.visitor_ID = v.ID AND CAST(m.Open_Year AS INTEGER) > 2011
);
